name: Timeline
description: A vertical timeline whose labels stick while their content scrolls past, with a line that fills with water as you go.

props.name: items
props.description: The entries, in order. The title sticks beside its content; each node fills when the line reaches it.

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading block above the timeline. Bring your own heading element.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer element. Set [--miyuki-timeline-top:7rem] to keep the sticky labels below a fixed header.
